name: agentic-github-flow-security
description: Security review of a change or repository: secret scanning, dependency audit against OSV, and a checklist by area.

interface.shortDescription: Security review of a change or repository: secret scanning, dependency audit against OSV, and a checklist by area.
interface.longDescription: A stack-neutral security review skill with two scripts that need only Python: a secret scanner that never prints values, and a lockfile audit against the OSV database with optional upgrade advice.
